# Incident report: <short title>

## Summary

Describe the user-visible issue without including secrets or personal location data.

## Timeline

| Time and timezone | Event |
|---|---|
| | Detection |
| | Impact mitigation |
| | Root cause identified |
| | Recovery verified |

## Impact

Describe affected application versions, operating systems, users, and whether provider credentials or location information were exposed. Do not publish sensitive details.

## Root cause

State the technical cause and distinguish evidence from assumptions.

## Resolution

Describe code, configuration, provider, or release actions taken. If a token was exposed, record that it was revoked or rotated, but never reproduce it.

## Validation

List tests, manual checks, and evidence that the incident is resolved.

## Follow-up actions

- [ ] Prevention:
- [ ] Detection:
- [ ] Documentation:
- [ ] Owner and target date:

## Lessons learned

Record practical changes that reduce recurrence. Keep the report factual and blame-free.
